items.title: Elementor <= 4.0.5 - Authenticated (Contributor+) Sensitive Information Exposure
items.summary: The Elementor Website Builder – More Than Just a Page Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in all versions up to, and including, 4.0.5 via /wp-json/elementor/v1/user REST endpoint. items.summary: split checks input/output identity by path before opening the output, then opens with truncation, leaving a race window on mutable path components. GNU opens first and compares the opened output inode against the input before truncating.
